notes.title: Demo Patch - Feb 25, 2025
notes.content:
Hello Survivors! Welcome to our 2/25 Demo Patch. The majority of our changes revolve around bug fixes and balance improvements. Stay safe out there…

If you experience any issues or have feedback, [url=https://discord.gg/PXVXbJmEwq]please share here in our official Discord[/url]. 

[h3]Fixes:
[/h3]
[b][Tutorial] [/b]
[list]
[*] Moved the crouch tutorial section farther up to prevent the player from getting stuck
[/list]
[b][Enemies][/b]
[list]
[*] Adjusted scaling on enemies spawning over time for solo players
[*] Enemy location is now better synced between host and non-hosts
[*] Fixed the physics issue that was preventing enemies killed by other players from ragdolling correctly
[/list]
[b][Gameplay][/b]
[list]
[*] Character no longer stuck in crawling state if moving while revived
[*] Remove ability to reopen small fuse boxes once empty
[*] Rebalanced torch damage to enemies
[*] Crafting more than one electronics for the generator no longer desyncs players’ objectives
[/list]
[b][UI] [/b]
[list]
[*] Melee and Ranged damage perks now have their corresponding images displayed correctly
[*] Fixed main menu trello link
[*] End cinematic audio volume is now connected to volume settings
[/list]

Download [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3364160/The_Rotting_Chronicles_Demo/]The Rotting Chronicles Demo[/url]!
